comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left is 1 if any comment's main basis is abstract normative principles (moral, ethical, rights, justice or value), contrasted with a specific concrete example. Right is 1 if any comment is a rebuttal of the OP through abstract logical reasoning (definitions, inference, consistency, conceptual distinctions), with no named real-world example or analogy. Normative-principle appeals are not the same as logical or conceptual argument. Right also requires the comment to be a rebuttal and excludes any analogy; left has neither condition. Left allows precedents to be cited alongside, while right does not allow named examples. The eligibility rules differ.
